import numpy as np

# Quaternions: gripper facing down, fingers opening along X (across the Y-aligned handle)
Q0_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # Arm0
Q1_DOWN_X = np.array([0.0, 0.707, -0.707, 0.0])  # Arm1 (= [0,0,1,0] rotated 90deg about z)

# Hammer pose: middle of handle; handle extends toward +Y, head toward -Y
hpos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
hx, hy, hz = float(hpos[0]), float(hpos[1]), float(hpos[2])

# Grasp offsets along the handle: Arm0 takes the head-side part of the handle (-Y),
# leaving the +Y part of the handle free for Arm1. 11cm separation > 8cm buffer.
OFF = 0.055
grasp_dz = 0.005               # fingertip point slightly above handle center
handover_x = 0.81              # midpoint between initial gripper x positions (0.44, 1.18)
handover_hammer_z = 0.175      # hammer z must be in [0.15, 0.20]
handover_grip_z = handover_hammer_z + grasp_dz

# ---- Arm0: grasp hammer handle near head side ----
open_gripper_arm0()
grasp0 = np.array([hx, hy - OFF, hz + grasp_dz])
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q0_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm0()

# ---- Arm0: lift straight up (translation only) ----
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([hx, hy - OFF, handover_grip_z]), Q0_DOWN_X)

# ---- Arm0: translate to handover point, keeping orientation and height ----
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([handover_x, hy - OFF, handover_grip_z]), Q0_DOWN_X)

# ---- Arm1: approach from above and grasp the free +Y part of the handle ----
open_gripper_arm1()
grasp1 = np.array([handover_x, hy + OFF, handover_grip_z])
goto_pose_arm1(grasp1, Q1_DOWN_X, z_approach=0.12)
close_gripper_arm1()

# ---- Arm0: release and retreat (up first, then back toward its own side) ----
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([handover_x, hy - OFF, handover_grip_z + 0.15]), Q0_DOWN_X)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.45, hy - OFF, handover_grip_z + 0.15]), Q0_DOWN_X)
